findings.title: totalPages is off by one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit
findings.body: totalPages is computed as Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. For a group with exactly 100 members and the default limit of 50 this yields 3 pages instead of 2. Since `showingLast` is derived from currentPage == totalPages and the `next` action clamps offset to user_count, the user can navigate to a phantom last page (offset == user_count) that renders an empty member list. The correct formula is Math.ceil(user_count / limit), or Math.floor((user_count - 1) / limit) + 1.

findings.title: add_members does not strip whitespace around usernames
findings.body: add_members splits the `usernames` param on commas and calls User.find_by_username(username) directly. If the submitted value contains spaces after commas (e.g. "alice, bob" — easy to produce if the input is edited manually), the lookup for " bob" silently fails and the user is not added, while the response still reports success. Each username should be stripped before the lookup, or the failure should be surfaced.

findings.title: findMembers returns undefined instead of a promise when the group has no name
findings.body: When the group's name is empty, findMembers now returns `undefined` (`return ;`) instead of a resolved promise as before. Callers such as the routes' setupController invoke it unconditionally; any caller that chains `.then` on the result (as the removed afterModel hooks did) will now throw a TypeError on unnamed/new groups. Return Ember.RSVP.resolve() to keep the contract consistent.
